comment: Findings against crates that the Wasmtime C API library links, and that
pkg/contrib cannot resolve by bumping the pin.  check-lock-audit.py fails
the audit on any other linked finding.  A finding outside the linked graph
needs no entry here; it is reported and ignored.
The version is part of the key, so a pin bump forces this file to be
reviewed again rather than carrying an acceptance forward silently.

allow.reason: Linked through rayon, which wasmtime pulls in for the parallel-compilation feature. The bug is an invalid pointer dereference in the fmt::Pointer impl of Atomic and Shared; neither wasmtime nor Unit formats an epoch pointer, so no call site reaches it. The archive is vendored and cannot be relocked, and wasmtime 48.x already resolves crossbeam-epoch 0.9.20, so the next pin bump clears this.

Linked through rand, which wasmtime-wasi uses to seed guest randomness. A yank is not an advisory: no RustSec record applies to this version. 0.10.1 is yanked as well and 0.10.2 is clean, but the archive is vendored, so the version moves only when the pin does.
